tickerText: [TENNIS] Wimbledon 2026 Saturday, July 11: Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova meet in the first all-Czech women's final in Wimbledon history on Centre Court — a guaranteed first-time Grand Slam champion after Muchova saved match point to beat Coco Gauff 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (12-10) and Noskova topped Marta Kostyuk 6-4, 6-4 • Sunday's men's final pits defending champion Jannik Sinner against Alexander Zverev after both won Friday's semis in straight sets • [SQUASH] Mohammad Syafiq Kamal and Tanvi Khanna both rallied from two games down to win HCL PSA Challenger titles in Mumbai on July 3 — Syafiq upset Egypt's Yassin Shohdy 6-11, 9-11, 11-8, 14-12, 11-8 while Khanna beat Farida Walid 8-11, 2-11, 12-10, 11-9, 11-7 for her fifth PSA crown • The 2026-27 tour calendar shifts to the Eastside Open in Hobart (July 22–26) and Victorian Open in Melbourne (July 29–Aug 2) • [BADMINTON] The DAIHATSU Japan Open Super 750 opens Monday July 14 at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium with a $950,000 purse — Indonesia fields 12 players led by Jonatan Christie and three men's doubles pairs, Malaysia's Man Wei Chong and Soh Wooi Yik debut their new partnership, and defending champions Goh Sze Fei and Nur Izzuddin start against China's Hu Ke Yuan and Lin Xiang Yi • [PICKLEBALL] The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne runs July 16–19 at Raya Pickleball Club and Pickle4Real with 407 players registered, followed by the inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open July 23–26 at The Sports Arina @ Expo — Singapore's first PPA Tour Asia stop carries a $70,000 purse on the road to October's $1.1 million Hong Kong Slam • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Brazil tickets enter their third release July 11 ahead of the July 21–26 event at Vale Sul Shopping in São José dos Campos — the first Star Contender in São Paulo state features world No. 5 Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi after Sun Yingsha claimed her sixth Grand Smash title at WTT United States Smash

newsItems.title: Muchova and Noskova Set Historic All-Czech Wimbledon Final
newsItems.excerpt: Saturday's Wimbledon women's final guarantees a first-time Grand Slam champion as Czech compatriots Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova meet on Centre Court. Muchova saved match point to topple Coco Gauff 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (12-10) in a Centre Court epic, while 21-year-old Noskova reached her first major final with a 6-4, 6-4 win over Marta Kostyuk. It is the first all-Czech women's final in Wimbledon history. Sunday's men's title match pits defending champion Jannik Sinner against Alexander Zverev.

newsItems.title: Syafiq and Khanna Stage Mumbai Comebacks Ahead of July Tour Slate
newsItems.excerpt: The HCL PSA Challenger in Mumbai closed July 3 with dramatic finals. Malaysia's Mohammad Syafiq Kamal rallied from two games down to beat Egypt's Yassin Shohdy 6-11, 9-11, 11-8, 14-12, 11-8 for his first PSA title in seven years. India's Tanvi Khanna also recovered from 0-2 to defeat Farida Walid 8-11, 2-11, 12-10, 11-9, 11-7, claiming her fifth PSA crown. The tour now turns to the Eastside Open in Hobart (July 22–26) and Victorian Open in Melbourne (July 29–Aug 2).

newsItems.title: PPA Tour Heads to Melbourne Then Singapore's Inaugural Open
newsItems.excerpt: Professional pickleball's July calendar centers on two Asia-Pacific stops. The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne runs July 16–19 at Raya Pickleball Club and Pickle4Real with 407 players registered. One week later, Singapore hosts its first PPA Tour Asia event — the Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open, July 23–26 at The Sports Arina @ Expo, a $70,000 stop on the road to October's $1.1 million Hong Kong Slam.

newsItems.title: WTT Star Contender Brazil Opens Third Ticket Release
newsItems.excerpt: The third batch of tickets for WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos 2026 goes on sale July 11 ahead of the July 21–26 event at Vale Sul Shopping. The first Star Contender in São Paulo state will feature world No. 5 Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi among 80-plus international players, following Sun Yingsha's sixth Grand Smash title at WTT United States Smash.
